name: Engine Oil Service Interval Exceeded

conclusion.title: Engine Oil & Filter Service Severely Overdue

explanation_template: Odometer interval since last oil change has exceeded 10,000 km and the engine oil shows black sludging, indicating thermal breakdown and depleted anti-wear additives.
recommended_action: Drain engine oil completely while warm, install new OEM oil filter, and refill with vehicle-specified synthetic oil grade.
preventive_maintenance: Change engine oil every 7,500-10,000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first.

name: Hydraulic Brake Fluid Moisture Contamination

conclusion.title: Brake Fluid Moisture Contamination (Vapour Lock Hazard)

explanation_template: Hygroscopic glycol brake fluid has absorbed >= 3% ambient moisture over 24+ months, reducing wet boiling point and creating vapour lock brake fade risk under sustained braking.
recommended_action: Flush complete hydraulic brake system with fresh unopened container of DOT 4 or DOT 5.1 brake fluid until clear at all bleeder screws.
preventive_maintenance: Flush brake fluid every 24 months regardless of distance driven.

name: Engine Coolant Anti-Corrosion Depletion

conclusion.title: Depleted Engine Coolant & Electrolytic Corrosion Risk

explanation_template: Coolant has been in service for 3+ years and turned rust-colored, indicating silicate/organic acid rust inhibitor depletion.
recommended_action: Flush cooling system with distilled water and radiator flush chemical, then refill with 50/50 mixture of specified long-life antifreeze.
preventive_maintenance: Replace standard ethylene glycol coolant every 3 years; long-life OAT coolant every 5 years.

name: Spark Plug Periodic Replacement Overdue

conclusion.title: Spark Plugs Electrode Wear & Misfire Risk

explanation_template: Spark plugs have exceeded 30,000 km with widened center electrode gap, placing excessive electrical load on ignition coils.
recommended_action: Replace complete set of spark plugs with vehicle manufacturer specified heat range plugs. Torque to spec with a calibrated torque wrench.
preventive_maintenance: Inspect conventional copper spark plugs every 20,000 km; iridium/platinum plugs every 60,000-100,000 km.

name: Engine Timing Belt Age / Mileage Replacement Due

conclusion.title: Timing Belt Replacement Critically Overdue (Catastrophic Valve Clash Risk)

explanation_template: Rubber timing belt has surpassed 90,000 km and exhibits back-rib microcracking. Belt snapping on an interference engine causes immediate piston-to-valve collision and total engine destruction.
recommended_action: Do not delay. Replace timing belt, tensioner pulley, idler bearings, and water pump as a comprehensive kit immediately.
preventive_maintenance: Replace timing belts strictly at 80,000-100,000 km or 5-7 years.

name: Tyre Tread Depth Below Legal Safety Threshold

conclusion.title: Tyre Tread Below 1.6mm Legal Limit (Hydroplaning Hazard)

explanation_template: Remaining tread depth is at or below the 1.6mm wear bar indicator, eliminating water evacuation channels and creating extreme hydroplaning hazard.
recommended_action: Replace tyres immediately. Check alignment to prevent premature wear on new tyres.
preventive_maintenance: Rotate tyres every 10,000 km and measure tread depths across inner, center, and outer grooves.

name: Auxiliary Serpentine Belt Glazing and Cracking
explanation_template: Accessory serpentine belt has 3+ cracks per inch on inner ribs and squeals on cold start, indicating rubber dry-rot and tension loss.
recommended_action: Replace serpentine drive belt and inspect automatic tensioner pulley bearing for smooth rotation.
preventive_maintenance: Inspect serpentine belt for oil contamination and rib cracks every 30,000 km.

name: Battery Terminal Heavy Sulfate Corrosion

conclusion.title: Corroded Battery Terminals & High Contact Resistance

explanation_template: Heavy white or bluish copper sulfate crystal growth around battery posts increases circuit electrical resistance.
recommended_action: Disconnect terminals (negative first). Clean posts and cable clamps with baking soda solution and wire brush. Reinstall and coat with dielectric grease.
preventive_maintenance: Apply anti-corrosion protective washers and grease to battery terminals annually.

name: Manual Transmission Gear Oil Replacement Due

conclusion.title: Degraded Manual Gearbox / Final Drive Hypoid Oil

explanation_template: Manual transmission gear oil has exceeded 50,000 km with increased shift lever stiffness in cold weather.
recommended_action: Drain gear oil, inspect drain plug magnet for metal filings, and refill with specified GL-4 or GL-5 hypoid gear oil.
preventive_maintenance: Check gearbox oil level at every major scheduled service.

name: Shock Absorber Hydraulic Fluid Seepage

conclusion.title: Blown Shock Absorber / Strut Hydraulic Seal

explanation_template: Visible hydraulic oil film on shock absorber damper body accompanied by multiple oscillation bounces after hitting bumps.
recommended_action: Replace shock absorbers or struts in axle pairs (both front or both rear) to maintain balanced handling.
preventive_maintenance: Perform bounce test and visual fluid check on dampers every 20,000 km.

name: Cabin HVAC Air Filter Dust & Pollen Clogged
explanation_template: Reduced air volume from dashboard vents accompanied by stale moldy odor caused by saturated cabin pollen filter.
recommended_action: Remove glovebox or cowl access panel and replace cabin air filter with activated carbon filter.
preventive_maintenance: Replace cabin filter every 15,000 km or 12 months.

name: Wheel Lug Nut Torque Inspection Alert

conclusion.title: Post-Service Wheel Lug Nut Retorque Required

explanation_template: Wheels were removed or replaced within the last 100 km and lug nuts have not been retorqued. Settlement of alloy wheels can cause nuts to back off.
recommended_action: Use a calibrated torque wrench in a crisscross star pattern to torque all wheel nuts to factory spec (typically 100-140 Nm).
preventive_maintenance: Always retorque wheel lug fasteners 50-100 km following tyre installation.

name: Exhaust System Muffler Corrosion & Perforation

conclusion.title: Perforated Exhaust Muffler / Tailpipe Corrosion Hole

explanation_template: Loud rumbling or buzzing exhaust note caused by road salt and acidic condensation rusting through outer muffler skin.
recommended_action: Weld repair or replace damaged muffler section and inspect exhaust rubber hanger donuts.
preventive_maintenance: Wash underbody to remove road salt during winter months.

name: Power Steering Hydraulic Fluid Oxidation

conclusion.title: Oxidized Power Steering Hydraulic Fluid & Pump Cavitation

explanation_template: Hydraulic power steering fluid has turned dark brown/black with burnt smell, causing pump whining and vane wear.
recommended_action: Siphon reservoir, flush power steering fluid with manufacturer-approved fluid (ATF or Pentosin), and bleed air by turning lock-to-lock.
preventive_maintenance: Flush power steering fluid every 60,000 km.

name: Windscreen Wiper Blade Rubber Streaking

conclusion.title: Worn or Torn Windscreen Wiper Blade Squeegees

explanation_template: Wiper rubber has hardened from UV exposure, leaving water streaks and chattering across the glass during rain.
recommended_action: Replace driver and passenger windscreen wiper blade assemblies.
preventive_maintenance: Clean wiper rubber with rubbing alcohol and replace annually before the wet season.
